glosses: Faire passer une connexion au travers d’un proxy.

examples.text: Il est donc possible de proxyfier les flux de toute application utilisant TCP pour communiquer avec un serveur distant.

glosses: Used as a proxy or acting as a proxy.
An agent or substitute authorized to act for another person.

examples.text: Every peer […] may make another lord of parliament his proxy, to vote for him in his absence.

glosses: The authority to act for another, especially when written.

examples.text: I have no man's proxy: I speak only for myself.

glosses: The written appointment of a proctor in suits in the ecclesiastical courts
A measurement of one physical quantity that is used as an indicator of the value of another
An interface for a service, especially for one that is remote, resource-intensive, or otherwise difficult to use directly.
To serve as a proxy for.

examples.text: In many of the studies we reviewed, it is common practice to use an observed variable to proxy for a relevant variable that could not be observed.

glosses: To function as a server for a client device, but pass on the requests to another server for service.
